page.overview:
Who is Candy Tavern People?

Candy Tavern People are minor characters who make a cameo appearance in "Apple Thief." Before Finn enters the Candy Tavern, a cherry falls out of the window, possibly due to a fight. Other Candy Tavern people include Cookie Guy, Candy Tavern Bartender, and many others. The majority of the Candy Tavern People are not directly acknowledged in the episode.

The Candy Tavern People reappear in the episode "Dream of Love," when Jake brings Mr. Pig over there after he is taken away from Tree Trunks. Some characters such as Jaybird, Wormo, and Smudge don't appear.
